reviews.body:
October unreviewed-202 review batch (2026-10-22)

Reviewed head `bf25239ffbb595dd34861497c9858e426a395c0c` against master `6042edaff34c4775afb5655e3517c8861825fb95`.

Change reviewed: fix: replace the retired claude-3-opus default of the built-in ClaudeLLM.

The new model-name tests pass and the Sonnet 4.6 ID/context value is documented by the provider (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-4-6/overview). Changing the built-in default from Opus to Sonnet changes model behavior and cost; it is a model migration, not a no-impact bug patch. Validate the configured SDK request path and an explicit migration decision before merging.

Validation:
- Current master with the same PR tests: 2 passed, 1 failed, 0 collection/setup errors, 0 skipped.
- Current master + PR: 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 collection/setup errors, 0 skipped.

comments.body:
Agreed that this is a model migration and not a no-impact patch: the previous default (`claude-3-opus-20240229`) is retired, so every request with the default LLM already returns a 404, and the change picks `claude-sonnet-4-6` as its replacement. Sonnet is cheaper than Opus; if the project prefers another replacement (for example `claude-opus-4-6`), only the yaml value changes, since both are in `ClaudeMAXCONTETNLENGTH` now.

On the request path: `ClaudeLLM._call` sends `model`, `temperature`, `stream` and `max_tokens` to `messages.create`, all accepted by `claude-sonnet-4-6`. While checking it, `_new_client` also passes `connection_pool_limits` to `anthropic.Anthropic`, which the current SDK rejects with a `TypeError`. That is independent of the model name, so it is not part of this PR; happy to send it as a separate one if wanted.
Hi @weizjajj, friendly ping: the points above should be addressed now. Could you take another look when you have a moment? Happy to change anything else.
